_comment: AutoForm view scheme for the FRET docking tool (IMP + IMP.bff). Short labels; detail lives in tooltips (description). Compute runs in dock_tool.py via api.operations.

sections.title: Inputs
sections.description: Structures and FRET restraints to model.

sections.label: PDB(s)
sections.description: One PDB per rigid body, comma-separated. Each body_id in the fps.json maps to one PDB.

sections.label: fps.json
sections.description: Labelling positions and experimental distances (fps.json).

sections.label: Output
sections.description: Directory for RMF trajectory, best-scoring PDBs and the score CSV.

sections.label: Op
sections.description: dock = rigid-body docking; refine = CG minimisation; screen = rank a library; score = single structure.

sections.label: Method
sections.description: Docking engine: minimize = fast IMP conjugate-gradient energy minimisation (default); mc = replica-exchange Monte-Carlo sampling.

sections.label: Score set
sections.description: Named chi2 score set in the fps.json (empty = all distances).

sections.title: Docking
sections.description: Docking controls (FPS-style: runs, iterations, clash, refinement).

sections.label: Runs
sections.description: Number of independent docking runs from random starts (FPS n_trials). >1 estimates the score spread; each run is plotted and listed in the results table and runs in parallel.

sections.label: Iterations
sections.description: Maximum docking iterations per run (FPS max_iter) — conjugate-gradient steps for minimize, Monte-Carlo frames for mc.

sections.label: Clash k
sections.description: Excluded-volume / clash penalty weight (FPS k_clash).

sections.label: Refine
sections.description: FPS-style refinement cycles after docking: re-compute the accessible volumes on the docked structure (real AV calc, accounting for inter-body occlusion) and re-minimise. 0 = none.

sections.label: Fixed body
sections.description: body_id kept fixed as the reference; the others are mobile.

sections.label: sigma_DA
sections.description: Width of the mean-position transfer function (FPS distance distribution width).

sections.title: Monte-Carlo (mc method only)
sections.description: Only used when Method = mc; ignored by the default minimize docking.

sections.label: MC steps
sections.description: Monte-Carlo steps per frame.

sections.label: Keep best
sections.description: Number of best-scoring PDB models to write.

sections.label: Anneal
sections.description: Enable the PMI simulated-annealing temperature schedule.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Populated after a run completes.

sections.label: Status
sections.description: Outcome of the last run.

sections.label: Score
sections.description: Total restraint score (FRET chi2 + excluded volume).

sections.label: Distances
sections.description: Number of experimental distances scored.
